scope: Twelve-variable 37-clause UNSAT fixture: peak 4 and 14 branch attempts agree with independent oracle/testing.
unverified: SCC-substitution Canon+ implementation, reconstruction, full cost and all-input bound.
Dovetailing requires accounting for actual machine work; does not prove any constituent polynomial.
corrections: Signed literal representatives must preserve complements; arbitrary independent representatives do not suffice.
Exponential counts of hypothetical satisfiable residuals do not imply the early-exit SAT solver actually visits them.
No bound on one algorithm proves a limitation on all polynomial-time SAT algorithms.
